name: Godshard
source:
Left to run a magic supply shop alone with her closest friend after her father abandoned them 10 years ago, Celica (Name Changeable) lives her day-to-day life under constant scrutiny.  In a world full of magic, Celica is perhaps the only person in the world without it. After a terrible accident caused by her mysterious condition and involving one of her customers, the locals have since come to know her as an emotionless monster. 

One day, her life is turned upside down as she goes through a series of events that will give her a temporary fix to her condition. 

But no remedy comes without a price, and she will find herself embroiled in events that will decide the fate of her kingdom.

Discover the cause of her mysterious condition, find her father, and uncover plots that run deep within the kingdom of Belerien. 

[From [url=https://ogpurin.itch.io/godshard]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
十年前，她的父亲抛弃了他们，塞莉卡（易名）与她最亲密的朋友独自经营一家魔法用品店，她的日常生活受到不断的审视。在充满魔法的世界里，塞莉卡或许是世界上唯一没有魔法的人。由于她神秘的病情引发了一场可怕的事故，事故还牵涉到她的一位顾客，当地人从此开始认为她是一个没有感情的怪物。

有一天，她的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化，因为她经历了一系列事件，这将使她的病情暂时得到缓解。

但任何补救措施都是有代价的，她会发现自己卷入了决定王国命运的事件中。

找出她神秘病症的原因，找到她的父亲，并揭开贝连王国深处的阴谋。

[来自[url=https://ogpurin.itch.io/godshard]itch.io[/url]]
